column1: # drive_name_terms.tsv -- the term dictionary read by tools/name_reduce.py
# Tab-separated, four columns.  Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Rules are applied by KIND, never in file order, so a rule can be added anywhere.
#   keep    a whole token, matched literally, that NO other     unused
#           rule may touch and that --report hides
#   token   a whole token, matched literally                   unused
#   regex   a whole token, matched by regex (implicit fullmatch)  unused
#   split   a whole token; the token becomes its capture groups  unused
#   strip   a substring inside a token, rewritten by repl       replacement text
# Matching is case-insensitive.  Put "cs:" at the start of the note to make one
# Put "struct:" at the start of a keep/keepre rule's note to say it guards
# STRUCTURE rather than a brand -- a revision letter, a class designator.  Such
# a rule is excluded from the vendor set --no-vendor tests against, so that
# "a keep rule fired" is not mistaken for "a vendor was recognised".  A note
# carries at most one of these prefixes.
# For a `strip` rule an EMPTY repl column is meaningful, not missing: it deletes
# the matched substring.  Write the tabs out in full so the note lands in column
# 4.  A pattern cannot contain a literal tab -- use \t.
# Because every rule matches a WHOLE token, the "\s+ either side" you would need
# in a flat regex is structural here -- do not write \s, ^ or $ in a pattern.
# (`pre` is the one exception: it sees the whole line, before tokenising.)
# PRECEDENCE.  Rules are grouped by kind and the groups run in this order:
#   pre  ->  split  ->  [keep guard]  ->  strip  ->  token/regex  ->  first
#        ->  dedup  ->  blank if every surviving token is kept
# Within a group, order does not matter.  Between groups it does:
#   * `keep`/`keepre` protect a token from `strip` and from `token`/`regex`.
#   * `first` overrides `keep` -- position is what tells a leading class
#     designator from a trailing revision suffix, and both are single letters.
#   * The final blank-if-all-kept pass is why a vendor with no model number
#     yields an empty line.  Disable it with --keep-vendor-only.
# Grow this file from the report, not from the corpus:
#     uv run python tools/name_reduce.py --stats     # 0 hits = a dead rule
#     uv run python tools/name_reduce.py --blanked   # names that vanished
# 1-2 digits, X, 1-2 digits, then any number of Xnn continuations, with an
# A speed run glued to a following word with no delimiter must be separated
# before either half can be matched as a token: "16X52X32X52COMBO".
